name: NeonSat-2 to 6
slot_a_text: First scheduled in 2025, it has moved three times since. The current time was set 2 months ago and has held since. There is a 1-hour window to work with.
slot_b_text: The 1st launch of the year for South Korea's KARI, 9th all time. Worldwide, it is attempt number 237 of the year.
description: NeonSat-2 to 6 are part of the South Korean government's Earth observation micro-satellite constellation NeonSat (New-space Earth Observation Satellite). The NeonSat constellation is the first satellite system developed by the government using a mass-production approach for precise monitoring of the Korean Peninsula.
rocket_fact: Nuri is designed to launch 1.5-ton payloads into Sun-Synchronous Orbit.
